nodes.label: Nginx Build Script (VOD + secure token)
nodes.rationale: Compiles nginx 1.27.4 from source with kaltura's nginx-vod-module and nginx-secure-token-module plus ngx_devel_kit and set-misc, none of which ship in distro packages. MAX_CLIPS is patched from 128 to 1080 so long recording playlists can be served, and avc_hevc_parser_rbsp_trailing_bits is patched to return TRUE early to work around frigate issue 4572. ccache is used to cut rebuild time.
